project: Pokemon Dream Radar DS/DSi homebrew demake
scope: Feature coverage audit; source presence and host tests do NOT establish original 3DS parity.

status_meanings.host_tested: Current approximate gameplay logic has portable regression tests; original parity unverified.
status_meanings.partial: Some DS behavior exists, but material original game behavior or presentation is missing.
status_meanings.investigation_only: Private original format metadata has been mapped; runtime behavior missing.
status_meanings.unimplemented: Original behavior is absent from the DS port.
status_meanings.hardware_limited: Original hardware feature unavailable on DS/DSi without alternate design.

features.feature: Title, intro and research lab navigation
features.gap: Screens and D-pad/touch routing implemented; not frame-perfect.

features.feature: Professor Burnet story and tutorials
features.gap: Dialogue and tips exist; exact original scene sequencing not independently verified.

features.feature: Dream Cloud generation and shooting
features.gap: Cloud-to-sphere encounters now preserve remaining unshot clouds and free-floating Orbs after results. A resumes the same scan; B abandons remaining targets; original distribution, cloud reactivity and camera behavior still lack end-to-end validation.

features.feature: Aim/beam input and capture
features.gap: Stylus/D-pad/A inputs work; original gyroscopic aiming is absent.

features.feature: Dream Orb currency and purchases
features.gap: Overflow-safe counters and shop pricing tested; exact color-dependent logic missing.

features.feature: Pink/green/orange/blue Dream Orb cycle
features.gap: Separate on-screen Dream Orbs now spawn from clouds, drift, cycle color individually, and must be shot before expiring; four colors unlock with Therian progression. Exact 3DS movement/physics, per-cloud sizing and timing remain provisional.

features.feature: Color-influenced next-search Pokémon encounter selection
features.gap: Colors are counted only when an individual orb is shot; dominant color is saved for next search and filters ordinary species. Exact weighted encounter rates are still provisional.

features.feature: Timed sphere chase and beam capture
features.gap: DS/DSi capture spheres now use five bounded difficulty profiles selected from the encounter species/type and dedicated legendary Extensions, with different hit radii, speeds, periodic evasion turns, and displayed profile labels. Original per-species parameter tables, animation and emulator timing remain unverified.

features.feature: Original sphere projectile/penalty attacks
features.gap: DS/DSi Legendary captures now launch three simultaneous, separately shootable energy balls; ordinary profiles retain staggered attacks. Independent collision, dodge/beam defense, class-specific penalties and cleanup are implemented; exact retail per-species patterns remain unverified.

features.feature: Beam, Energy and Visoscope upgrades
features.gap: Five levels and Dream Orb costs tested; original animation/effects not exact.

features.feature: Vortex, Dragnet and Energy Recharge
features.gap: Encounter-local effects and inventory enforcement tested; visuals not authentic.

features.feature: All 17 research/simulator/secret Extension menu entries
features.gap: Extension enums, gates and prices implemented; original encounter tables pending.

features.feature: Retrieval favors Pokémon; Dowsing favors items
features.gap: Opposing bias implemented and tested; numerical odds are provisional.

features.feature: Simulator α/β/γ award their special item pools
features.gap: Six-item original pool identities, storage and cancellation tested; odds unverified.

features.feature: Therian Tornadus, Thundurus and Landorus story
features.gap: Unlock phases and basic legendary capture work; effects/forms not fully reproduced.

features.feature: Diamond/Pearl/Platinum/HeartGold/SoulSilver special bosses
features.gap: DS cart game-code detection and legendary Extension gating exist; full transfer behavior absent.

features.feature: Beldum, Slowpoke, Hoothoot secret codes
features.gap: International button sequences accepted; regional variants and repeat-use parity need review.

features.feature: All original obtainable Pokémon and encounter probabilities
features.gap: 26 named species supported, but spawn tables and form presentation are provisional.

features.feature: All original item names and drops
features.gap: 23 extracted English names supported, but drop tables are not proven original.

features.feature: Six Pokémon slots and six item stacks with replacement
features.gap: Portable storage/replacement tested; original separate legendary priority remains missing.

features.feature: Separate special legendary row and priority on transfer
features.gap: Homebrew queue uses six ordinary Pokémon slots instead of original transfer ordering.

features.feature: Durable homebrew save/restore and recovery
features.gap: Private save version/checksum and recovery tests; never equate with retail save data.

features.feature: Nintendo DS dual-screen and tactile/touch navigation
features.gap: Main controls and hitboxes exist; exact original touch layout is not proven.

features.feature: DSi outer camera live preview and optional album
features.gap: DSi camera API and fallback present; real DSi gameplay boot testing still pending.

features.feature: Original 3DS gyroscope aiming
features.gap: DS/DSi has no built-in 3DS gyroscope; needs explicitly designed alternative.

features.feature: Original stereoscopic 3DS rendering
features.gap: Nintendo DS/DSi has no autostereoscopic 3D display; 2D adaptation only.

features.feature: Original BCLIM graphics mapped to DS assets
features.gap: Conversion and SD override exist; wholesale original UI integration is incomplete.

features.feature: Original BCLYT screen positions and pane hierarchy
features.gap: 135 original layouts inventoried; runtime compositor retargeting not integrated.

features.feature: Original BCLAN animation keyframes and playback
features.gap: Clip lengths and loop flags identified; actual keyframe decoding and rendering pending.

features.feature: Original Pokémon 3D geometry and animations
features.gap: Optional converted DRM1 wireframes work; authentic original rigs/textures not integrated.

features.feature: Original music, sound effects and timing
features.gap: No verified original 3DS audio conversion and playback across scenes.

features.feature: Real Black 2/White 2 Nintendo 3DS Link transfers
features.gap: Only a safe text archive is exported; no retail transfer, save injection or handshake.

features.feature: Unova Link receiving Pokémon/items into Black 2/White 2
features.gap: No compatible send/receive implementation or save-verified integration.

features.feature: Original hidden-ability and badge-dependent levels
features.gap: Without genuine Pokémon transfer payloads these properties are not delivered.

features.feature: Original complete language selection and translated UI
features.gap: Extracted localized assets exist; complete in-game per-language switching is absent.

features.feature: Boot, input, performance, save tests on DS/DSi and emulator
features.gap: CI compiles ROMs and runs portable tests; reliable end-to-end gameplay test still pending.
